subject.title: fix(canvas): reject oversized A2UI JSONL files before dispatch

question: Should Canvas intentionally reserve a fixed 64 KiB and reject payloads that may fit the current Gateway, or must it preserve the effective existing range by sharing or computing the actual node-invocation frame budget?
rationale: The safer memory behavior is clear, but choosing a permanently smaller public Canvas payload range is a compatibility decision that cannot be inferred from the Gateway's advertised maximum alone.

options.title: Preserve the effective Gateway range
options.body: Replace the fixed reserve with a shared or exact serialized-frame calculation and test both the accepted and rejected boundaries.

options.title: Accept the conservative reserve
options.body: Keep the 64 KiB margin as an intentional compatibility change and document and prove the new Canvas ceiling before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve the effective Gateway range
recommendation.body: Replace the fixed reserve with a shared or exact serialized-frame calculation and test both the accepted and rejected boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history includes introducing and repeatedly maintaining the Canvas plugin and tool behavior affected by this public boundary.
